title: Langur spa day (grooming follows rank)

scenes.top_text: Me getting a full spa treatment because I'm 'senior management'
Me 'checking for ticks' while collecting every bit of troop gossip

scenes.headline: Langur grooming isn't just hygiene. It's politics.
scenes.body: In Hanuman langurs, grooming follows rank: dominant langurs groom each other and get groomed more often than subordinates.

caption:
Who grooms whom is never random.

In a langur troop, grooming tracks the pecking order, so watching who does the picking tells you who's in charge. Next time you see langurs on a temple wall or a forest road, watch who's working and who's relaxing.

Source: Animal Diversity Web (Semnopithecus entellus).  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Relatable office-hierarchy meme over our own CC langur clip; the punchline is a real, sourced behaviour (grooming follows dominance), so the joke teaches. Clip species shown as 'langurs' (gray langur type).
